brainlife.desc: Directory of binary NIfTI masks, one per tract, on a reference image grid; similar to neuro/rois.
brainlife.name: neuro/tractmasks

original.desc: (might be deprecated by neuro/rois in the future) List of nifti volumes for each tract segments. Each nifti files should be binarized (contains either 0 or 1). This datatype is very similar to neuro/rois (neuro/rois a bit more generic). We recommend using neuro/rois instead to increase compatibilities with more apps.

file_descs.masks: A directory containing nifti files with binarized (0 or 1) tract masks.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Tract volume, overlap (Dice) and shape measures, and training TractSeg. Warping tract masks between subject and template space.

**Not for:** Streamline-level analyses; masks lose streamline geometry. New pipelines where neuro/rois is supported (the datatype may be deprecated).

**BIDS:** dwi/mask (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 12 Apps, output of 11 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tractmasks.json

files.desc: A directory containing nifti files with binarized (0 or 1) tract masks.

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
